correctness.rationale: Verified the full inverse-face continuity definition, including empty domain, singleton image and target-edge preimages. If no target center, a map has all singleton fibers or exactly one source edge fiber; if target center is present, the rank-two edge and rank>=3 centered-star cases exhaust possibilities. Rank enumeration yields R_n, and the regularity obstruction is precisely center as singleton fiber mapping to a leaf while at least one other target leaf is used. Idempotence requires fixing the entire image, giving E_n=(1+z)^(n+1)+nz(1+z)^(n-1)+nz. Independent full partial-map enumeration for n=2,3,4,5 gave totals (36,185,1278,10857), nonregular (4,36,288,2500), idempotents (14,31,68,149). Additionally, all candidate regular witnesses were exhausted for n=2,3 with zero mismatches. The proof, not the small enumerations, establishes every n>=3.
